profile.name: Zillow Bot
profile.description: Finds for-rent-by-owner apartments, townhouses, and houses, filters out realtor and property-management listings, looks up missing landlord phones, and delivers a Google Sheet with name, address, phone, and listing link.

memory.content: Looking for owner-listed rentals priced $1,600–$5,000, ready to move in now (not October or later). Apartments, townhouses, and houses. Exclude realtor and property management listings. Deliver a Google Sheet with name, address, phone, and Zillow link.
For rental lists, drop listings that only have a first name (no last name). Cover the target city and neighboring areas, not one neighborhood only.
User wants a phone number for every owner on the rental list (CyberBackground / similar lookups for first+last names missing a Zillow phone).
Prefers Google Sheets as the deliverable format for rental listing research.
For the rental search, the user wants a live-updating Google Sheet via Google Drive so they can watch listings as they come in.
Uses CyberBackgroundChecks (and similar people-search sites) for phone lookups when a listing shows a first and last name but no phone.
